🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Your phone's GPS relies on Albert Einstein's mind-bending physics to tell you where you are!

Here's the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 GPS satellites orbit thousands of miles above Earth at incredible speeds.
🔹 Einstein's relativity predicts time passes differently for them due to speed and gravity.
🔹 Satellite clocks actually run about 38 microseconds faster per day than clocks on Earth.
🔹 Without constant, precise corrections for this time difference, your GPS would be wrong by several miles daily!
